name: staff_block
verifies: par-magic: the staff in the magic stance — readying a spell with the staff drawn moves the staff into the left hand (Hero_Stand_Staff_Cast_* motions); RMB raises the staff block (PS_Magic_StaffParade) instead of aborting the spell; a cast during the block lowers it and casts; without a staff RMB does nothing to the spell
notes: The staffblock lines must say 'block up True' for the staff runs (with combatlog on: 'staff block up', motion Hero_Stand_Staff_Cast_P0_Parade_Begin then Hero_Parade_Staff_Cast_P0_Ambient_Loop; with Perk_StaffMagic the shield effect eff_magic_parade_shield_01 if the effect library has it). The first staffblock (no staff) must keep the spell readied. Docs/screens/staff_cast_stance.png: staff in the left hand, spell glow in the right. Under the extended AI the block ends by itself after 1.5 s.
